mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_shop us JOIN sys_dept scope ON scope.dept_id=us.dept_id JOIN sys_dept target ON 1=1 WHERE target.dept_id=owned.owner_dept_id AND us.user_id=#{actor} AND scope.status='0' AND scope.del_flag='0' AND scope.dept_type IN ('GROUP','COMPANY','STORE','WAREHOUSE') AND target.status='0' AND target.del_flag='0' AND (target.dept_id=scope.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(scope.dept_id,target.ancestors)))
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT profile_id FROM sys_user_profile WHERE user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_attendance_leave_type WHERE leave_type_id=#{leaveTypeId} AND status='ENABLED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_shop us JOIN sys_dept scope ON scope.dept_id=us.dept_id JOIN sys_dept target ON target.dept_id=#{deptId} WHERE us.user_id=#{actor} AND scope.status='0' AND scope.del_flag='0' AND scope.dept_type IN ('GROUP','COMPANY','STORE','WAREHOUSE') AND target.status='0' AND target.del_flag='0' AND (target.dept_id=scope.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(scope.dept_id,target.ancestors))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dept d JOIN sys_dept owner ON owner.dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(owner.dept_id,d.ancestors) JOIN sys_legal_entity le ON le.legal_entity_id=owner.legal_entity_id WHERE d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND le.legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId} AND le.status='0' AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' AND owner.status='0' AND owner.del_flag='0'

SELECT DISTINCT r.leave_type_id FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule r JOIN oa_attendance_leave_type t ON t.leave_type_id=r.leave_type_id AND t.status='ENABLED' WHERE r.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY r.leave_type_id
SELECT owned.* FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule owned WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER BY family_id,version DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_tier WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} ORDER BY min_years
SELECT MAX(version) FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule WHERE family_id=#{familyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule SET family_id=rule_id WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND family_id IS NULL
UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule SET status='PUBLISHED',row_version=row_version+1,published_by=#{actor},published_at=NOW() WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND row_version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT owned.* FROM oa_attendance_leave_work_location owned WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER BY mapping_id LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_work_location WHERE mapping_id=#{mappingId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.* FROM oa_attendance_leave_work_location m JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=#{context.deptId} AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' WHERE m.legal_entity_id=#{context.legalEntityId} AND BINARY m.work_location=BINARY TRIM(#{context.workLocation}) AND (m.owner_dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(m.owner_dept_id,d.ancestors)) ORDER BY m.mapping_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.* FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule r JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=#{context.deptId} AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' JOIN sys_legal_entity le ON le.legal_entity_id=r.legal_entity_id AND le.status='0' WHERE r.legal_entity_id=#{context.legalEntityId} AND r.leave_type_id=#{leaveTypeId} AND BINARY r.location_code=BINARY #{locationCode} AND r.status='PUBLISHED' AND r.effective_from <= #{asOf} AND r.effective_to >= #{asOf} AND (r.owner_dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(r.owner_dept_id,d.ancestors)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule n WHERE n.family_id=r.family_id AND n.version>r.version AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.effective_from<=#{asOf} AND n.effective_to>=#{asOf}) ORDER BY r.priority DESC,r.rule_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_attendance_leave_balance_account(user_id,leave_type_id) VALUES(#{userId},#{leaveTypeId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(account_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_account WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND leave_type_id=#{leaveTypeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_balance_account SET row_version=row_version+1 WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_bucket WHERE account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY expires_on,bucket_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_command WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND BINARY command_key=BINARY #{commandKey}
SELECT * FROM oa_attendance_leave_balance_ledger WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND ledger_id<#{beforeId} ORDER BY ledger_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_balance_rule SET name=#{name},location_code=#{locationCode},priority=#{priority},effective_from=#{effectiveFrom},effective_to=#{effectiveTo},config_json=#{configJson},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} AND row_version=#{rowVersion} AND status='DRAFT'

UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_work_location SET work_location=#{workLocation},location_code=#{locationCode},reason=#{reason},updated_by=#{updatedBy},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE mapping_id=#{mappingId} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

UPDATE oa_attendance_leave_balance_bucket SET rule_id=#{ruleId},mapping_id=#{mappingId},mapping_version=#{mappingVersion},owner_dept_id=#{ownerDeptId},legal_entity_id=#{legalEntityId},context_fingerprint=#{contextFingerprint},expires_on=#{expiresOn},expiry_state=#{expiryState},granted_units=#{grantedUnits},rule_granted_units=#{ruleGrantedUnits},reserved_units=#{reservedUnits},consumed_units=#{consumedUnits},expired_units=#{expiredUnits},carried_units=#{carriedUnits},display_unit=#{displayUnit},minutes_per_day=#{minutesPerDay},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE bucket_id=#{bucketId} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
